title: 5 Free Credentials Before Graduation
subtitle: Five official programs offering free credentials, badges, or certificates — plus the reason you should only finish one of them.
fromVideo: From the video: 5 free credentials students can realistically complete now
intro: If your resume says AI, marketing, or tech with nothing to prove it, this fixes that. All five are free and official. How you use them matters more than which one you pick.

entries.title: AI Fundamentals
entries.lead: IBM's free learning platform for students. AI Fundamentals is listed on their digital credentials page.
entries.bestFor: Wanting to say “AI” on a resume and mean it
entries.pairWith: A project where you actually used an AI tool to do something, and can explain what it got wrong.

entries.title: Introduction to IoT and Digital Transformation
entries.lead: The course the video calls “Introduction to IoT.”
entries.pairWith: Anything you have physically built, wired, or automated.

action.label: Open the official page
action.note: Cisco’s Skills for All site now redirects here — same course, new home.

entries.title: Critical Thinking in the AI Era
entries.lead: HP’s free course library with online certificates.
entries.bestFor: The reasoning skill rather than a specific tool
entries.pairWith: A research brief or an analysis where you had to decide what to trust.

action.label: Open the official page
action.note: Search the course list for the AI-era critical thinking course.

entries.title: Digital Marketing Certification
entries.lead: A free certification course. The course page lists the lessons and shows a sample certificate.
entries.bestFor: Running social, events, or anything that needs an audience
entries.pairWith: A real campaign — a club account, a fundraiser, a school event you promoted.

entries.title: Content Marketing for SEO and AI Search
entries.lead: Free courses and certifications on how content gets found, including in AI search.
entries.bestFor: Writing, posting, or wanting to understand why some things get seen
entries.pairWith: Something you published and can show the numbers for.

rule.title: Pick one. Finish it. Then build something.
rule.body: An unfinished course is worth exactly nothing. Five badges and no projects reads worse than one badge and one finished thing.
items: Pick the one that matches a project you already want to build.
Finish it before you start another.
Put the project on your resume, with the credential underneath it.

verifyNote: All five links were opened and confirmed live on that date. Every provider asks you to create a free account before you can start — none of them charge. Program availability, course names, and eligibility change, so open the official page and check before you enrol.
